# What the ChatGPT codex backend is told ganja is, and what it serves back.
#
# The baseline W3 of .omc/plans/2026-08-25-ganja-code-identity-headers.md diffs
# against: a roster measured after the rename proves nothing without the roster
# measured before it. Recorded by `tests/codex_identity_probe.rs`, whose module
# doc holds the command, the gate and the three things this cannot measure.
#
# Build: ganja-code 0.1.0
# Note:  post-commit-2 tree: originator+UA ganja-code on the codex backend; ganja auth login (browser) completed 2026-08-25 under originator=ganja-code

== identity headers ==
# Captured off a loopback socket this process owns. The quartet below is decided
# by Backend::Codex and not by the endpoint, so these are the bytes the live
# turn sent, read somewhere they can be read. The two credential-bearing values
# are written as presence alone: a type that cannot render them decides that,
# and a token's length changes on every renewal, which this block should not
# diff on.
authorization: <redacted: present>
chatgpt-account-id: <redacted: present>
originator: ganja-code
openai-beta: responses=experimental
user-agent: ganja-code/0.1.0

# Also sent, names only: a header set that dropped what it did not
# recognise would hide the next one somebody adds.
also sent: accept, content-length, content-type, host

== the live turn ==
# Against the real backend. The wire reports no served-model field, so
# what is recorded is the model asked for and whether it was accepted.
# Offered is not servable: SUBSCRIPTION_DEFAULT is deliberately outside
# the roster below, so unless GANJA_MODEL named a roster member this
# turn is a sixth ask rather than one of the five.
model asked: gpt-5.4
outcome: served
finish: Completed
usage: input=21 output=5 cache_read=0 reasoning=0
reply: "pong"

== what this build offers a seat ==
# responses::SEAT_ROSTER, compile-time and reached by no network
# (D476). Recorded as what ganja volunteers, never as a measurement:
# the ladder below is the measured half.
notice: pinned to what a ChatGPT subscription is offered; --refresh does not apply
default: gpt-5.4
offered: gpt-5.5 (gpt-5.5)
offered: gpt-5.6-sol (gpt-5.6-sol)
offered: gpt-5.6-terra (gpt-5.6-terra)
offered: gpt-5.6-luna (gpt-5.6-luna)
offered: gpt-5.3-codex-spark (gpt-5.3-codex-spark)

== the ladder ==
# One ask per offered model, in the roster's own order. This is the
# acceptance artifact: a cohort demotion is a row that moves from
# served to refused. A refusal body is verbatim to 400 characters and
# arrives already masked against the presented credential; a longer one
# is cut on a char boundary and ends in an ellipsis. Line breaks inside
# one are flattened to spaces, so a row stays a row.
gpt-5.5: served
gpt-5.6-sol: served
gpt-5.6-terra: served
gpt-5.6-luna: served
gpt-5.3-codex-spark: served
